name: SinelaboreRT
description: A code generator that imports state-machine or activity models from XMI and produces source code for languages including C, C++, Java, C#, Python, Rust, Go, and JavaScript.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 状态机图和活动图代码生成工具，现已支持SysML v2状态机。先在EA、Visual Paradigm 、Cadifra、UModel、MagicDraw、Papyrus、ArgoUML、StarUML、DrawIO等UML建模工具中建立状态机模型，然后导出为XMI文件。sinelaboreRT将XMI文件导入，生成源代码。支持的编程语言包括：C、C++、Java、C#、Lua、Swift、Python、Rust、GO、JavaScript。
